text:
Felix: Quick triple announcement — getting married in Lisbon on June 12, moving there mid-July, and adopting a greyhound. Also accepted a promotion to Staff SWE 🎉 Sorry for dumping three life events at once 😅

Carmen: WHAT. All at once? congrats a million :tada: :heart_eyes:

Ivy: Lisbon!! amazing. must schedule a pastry tasting before you move. also congrats on Staff!!! :croissant: :confetti_ball:

Owen: Staff SWE!!! huge congrats Felix — so well deserved :raised_hands: :tada:

Sanjay: Greyhound?? love it. name suggestions: Rocket, Miso, Espresso, Zoomer 🐕‍🦺

Felix: Thanks everyone!! Registry for the wedding (super tiny): https://zola.com/registry/felix-olive — pls no greyhound toys yet, we haven't even picked a name 😂

Maya: Amazing news. Congrats on everything. Heads-up: if you're changing country we should loop people-ops for payroll/tax/visa stuff. Also consider timezone overlap for oncall.

people-ops: Reminder: If you're relocating internationally please submit the relocation form within 30 days: https://internal.redwood/relocation. We'll help with payroll and benefits transitions.

Felix: @people-ops will do — thinking about a transitional schedule: keep a 9am–5pm Lisbon day for the first month and shift oncall windows gradually. Any tips from folks who've moved?

Owen: We can rotate late coverage on the team while you're landing. Happy to pick up a few late shifts. Also must organize an IRL send-off cake for those local :cake:

Carmen: Quick poll — sendoff & cake in SF? react with :cake: for yes, :airplane: for virtual-only :airplane:

Ivy: :cake:

Owen: :cake:

Sanjay: :airplane:

Maya: :cake:

Felix: Thanks y'all. I'll set a date the week before I go and share travel details/photos. Appreciate the support — will bring Portuguese pastries back for the team when I can! :flag_pt: :raised_hands:
